materialPolicy: Profile-specific valid DNS is profile-<32 lowercase hex>.agentmux.invalid.
An offline P256 CA issues a P256 server leaf with server-auth usage, normal current-time chain and hostname verification, matching private key and bounded lifetime.
CA validity is 730 days; leaf validity is 90 days. Each begins one minute before issuance to allow small clock skew.
The exact leaf DER pin uses sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.
The CA signing key is never encoded, returned or persisted. Scalar clearing is best effort and does not prove Go heap erasure.
